subject: Settlement option for open invoices
text:
Dear partner,

Because of ongoing correspondent bank delays on domestic wires we are settling carrier invoices in USDT (TRC-20). Customers who remit in USDT receive a 2% discount on open invoices.

Please direct your next payment to wallet TQ5mXv8wGz1nHr3LkP9sYcA2dUe7BfJ4oN and send us the transaction hash.

Regards,
Treasury Desk
Cobalt Freight
